clue.text: Three revolutionary leaders, and unknown red

annotationWithheld.why: Three revolutionary leaders, and unknown red (6): Y is 'unknown' and 'red' the definition, but no sound reading of 'Three revolutionary leaders' gives CHERR (CHE plus two Rs is unexplained); no blog found
annotationWithheld.clue: Three revolutionary leaders, and unknown red

clue.text: Bread only for material

parts.note: bread is slang for money, cash
mere means only, nothing more than

explanation.surface: A complaint that bread is the only thing used for making fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: Cashmere is a fine soft wool fabric made from goat hair.

clue.text: Tongue with which person ate crackers

indicators.note: crackers means crazy, so the letters of the two words are scrambled

explanation.surface: A language spoken by someone who ate crackers.
explanation.definitionFit: Esperanto is an invented international language, and a tongue is a language.

clue.text: Space where uncultivated land turned over

indicators.note: turned over says the word for uncultivated land is read backwards

parts.note: a moor is open uncultivated upland

explanation.surface: A place where a stretch of wild land has been ploughed.
explanation.definitionFit: Room means space, as in room to move.

clue.text: Prompt one to take girl, being reckless

parts.note: to prod is to prompt or urge on
I is the Roman numeral for one
gal is an informal word for girl

explanation.surface: Urging someone to take a girl out when they are acting rashly.
explanation.definitionFit: Prodigal means wastefully extravagant, recklessly spending.

clue.text: Emerald I fashioned for the lower classes

indicators.note: fashioned means shaped or made anew, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A jeweller crafted an emerald for the working classes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lower classes' suggests social rank, but means school classes for weaker pupils.
explanation.definitionFit: Remedial teaching is aimed at the lower sets of pupils who need extra help.

clue.text: End of bed — there's the pillow, idiot!

indicators.note: end of picks out the final letter of the word bed

parts.note: a pillow lies under your head, so the phrase gives under-head as a location

explanation.surface: Someone exasperated, pointing to the pillow at the foot of the bed and calling a person an idiot.
explanation.definitionFit: A dunderhead is a slow-witted, stupid person.

clue.text: Princess, on climbing, frozen

indicators.note: in a down entry climbing means the letters are read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: Di is short for Princess Diana
on is the leg side in cricket

explanation.surface: A princess climbing a mountain and freezing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On' as LEG is the cricket term for the leg side of the field.
explanation.definitionFit: Gelid is a literary word meaning icy cold.

clue.text: Draw round one with halo's shine

indicators.note: round says one piece is placed around the other

parts.note: to lure is to draw or entice
a saint, abbreviated St, is depicted with a halo

explanation.surface: Sketching a figure with a shining halo.
explanation.definitionFit: Lustre is a gentle sheen or shine on a surface.

clue.text: Mountain in the country

parts.note: ben is a Scottish word for a mountain, as in Ben Nevis

explanation.surface: A mountain located in the countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: Benin is a country in West Africa.

clue.text: Fancy drink given to model

parts.note: to sup is to drink
to pose is to model for an artist

explanation.surface: A fancy drink handed to a model.
explanation.definitionFit: To fancy something is to imagine or suppose it.

clue.text: Mutilates a thousand fishes

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
angles means fishes with rod and line

explanation.surface: A grim report of someone butchering a thousand fish.
explanation.definitionFit: To mangle is to mutilate or damage badly by crushing or tearing.

clue.text: Sign name

definitions.meaning: a name or brand, as in a trademark, or an X signed in place of a name

explanation.definitionFit: A mark is both an indicating sign and a signature substitute for a name.

clue.text: Thought interpreter to be Danish at first, remainder given translation

indicators.note: translation means rendering into new form, so the pooled letters are rearranged
at first takes only the opening letter of Danish

explanation.surface: Someone translating a Danish text, starting with the remainder.
explanation.definitionFit: A mind-reader claims to perceive and interpret other people's thoughts.

clue.text: Unlikely to run far, cut Oslo out

indicators.note: out means wrong or off, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A traveller deciding not to run far and cutting Oslo out of the itinerary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Run' suggests jogging, but here dye running in the wash.
explanation.definitionFit: Colourfast fabric keeps its dye, so its colours will not bleed.

clue.text: Author's unfinished "Kidnapped" demand?

indicators.note: unfinished means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: Arthur Ransome is the author of Swallows and Amazons

explanation.surface: A writer's incomplete novel called Kidnapped.
explanation.walkthrough: Kidnapped is also a Stevenson novel, which makes the author look like Stevenson.
explanation.definitionFit: Kidnappers demand payment for releasing a captive.

clue.text: Royal staff to guard the new weapon

indicators.note: guarding something means surrounding it, so one piece goes outside the other

parts.note: a mace is a ceremonial staff carried before royalty

indicators.note: new means made afresh, so the word the is rearranged

explanation.surface: A royal staff protecting a new weapon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Royal staff' reads as courtiers, but it is the ceremonial rod; 'new' shuffles the three-letter word to HET before it goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A machete is a broad heavy knife used as a tool or weapon.

clue.text: Fault lies in empty term for systematic violence

indicators.note: in places the first pieces inside the remaining one
empty removes the inside of term, keeping its ends

parts.note: an error is a fault or mistake
lies in the sense of is situated gives is

explanation.surface: The real problem is a misleading word for organised violence.
explanation.definitionFit: Terrorism is the systematic use of violence to intimidate for political ends.

clue.text: Crucial to block muddled Cable, so fight evidence

indicators.note: to block is to sit in the way, so one piece goes inside the other
muddled says the letters of Cable are mixed up

parts.note: key means crucial, as in a key point

explanation.surface: It was vital to stop the confused Vince Cable, so there's proof of a punch-up.
explanation.walkthrough: Cable is Vince Cable, a British Liberal Democrat politician, which disguises the anagram; 'muddled' gives BLACE, and the key goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A bruised eye is the visible evidence of having been in a fight.

clue.text: Alien killer zapping fifty

indicators.note: zapping means eliminating, so the letter is removed

parts.note: a strangler is a killer
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A space alien killer shooting down fifty victims.
explanation.definitionFit: A stranger is an outsider or foreigner, someone alien to a place.

clue.text: Glass left in the cheap airline seating, almost knocked over

indicators.note: in puts one piece inside the other
knocked over means upended, so the letters are reversed
almost drops the final letter

parts.note: economy is the cheapest class of airline seating

explanation.surface: A glass left in economy class gets knocked over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims ECONOMY to ECONOM, which 'knocked over' reverses to MONOCE, with L going 'in'.
explanation.definitionFit: A monocle is a single eyeglass, so it is a glass.

clue.text: Upper chamber to which some beggar retires

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An attic room where a beggar goes to sleep.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition included 'to which', but those words only link the definition to the wordplay; 'Upper chamber' alone defines.
explanation.definitionFit: A garret is a small attic room at the top of a house.

clue.text: Stand-up comedian stifling posh, very loud laugh

indicators.note: stifling means smothering, so one piece goes inside the other
in a down entry stand-up means the word is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: a wag is a joker or comedian
U means upper-class, posh
ff (fortissimo) is the musical mark for very loud

explanation.surface: A stand-up comic suppressing a posh, very loud laugh.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stand-up comedian' looks like one phrase; 'Stand-up' reverses WAG to GAW.
explanation.definitionFit: A guffaw is a loud, hearty burst of laughter.

clue.text: Reduce to small shreds for jar

definitions.meaning: to shred food by rubbing it on a rough surface, as cheese
to jar is to irritate, rub up the wrong way

explanation.surface: A recipe step of shredding something for a jar.
explanation.definitionFit: Grating both shreds food finely and, figuratively, jars on the nerves.

definitions.meaning: a line of low strokes is the typographic character drawn beneath text
nineteen is one under a score, twenty

explanation.definitionFit: A typed underline character, and also 'under score' since nineteen is one less than twenty.

clue.text: Hindu garment boiling in Delhi's outskirts

indicators.note: in puts one piece inside the other
outskirts means the outer letters of the word

parts.note: boiling means very hot

explanation.surface: A Hindu garment worn in the sweltering suburbs of Delhi.
explanation.definitionFit: A dhoti is a loincloth worn by Hindu men in India.

clue.text: Star flower given back

indicators.note: given back means returned, so the word is reversed

parts.note: a flower is something that flows, a river, here the Avon

explanation.surface: A star flower returned as a gift.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flower' is crossword shorthand for a river.
explanation.definitionFit: A nova is a star that suddenly brightens hugely.

clue.text: Talk about thick fruit!

indicators.note: talk about signals a word said out loud

parts.note: thick means slow-witted, slow

explanation.surface: An exclamation about a dense piece of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A sloe is the small bitter fruit of the blackthorn.

clue.text: Pay on time for some film

parts.note: to foot the bill is to pay it
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Paying on time for a bit of film.
explanation.definitionFit: Footage is recorded film material.

clue.text: Significant relation

definitions.meaning: ... as an adjective means revealing or significant
a relation is a narration, an act of recounting a story

explanation.definitionFit: Telling means significant or revealing, and also narration of events.

clue.text: He painted an old kettle, say

definitions.meaning: James McNeill ... was an American painter
a kettle that whistles on the boil, typical of old stovetop kettles

explanation.definitionFit: Whistler is a famous painter's surname and a whistling kettle.

clue.text: One smiling, observing wayward delivery

definitions.meaning: someone who beams is smiling broadly
in cricket a ... is a ball that reaches the batsman head-high without bouncing

explanation.walkthrough: A beamer is a cricket term: a dangerous full toss at head height.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone grinning beams, and a head-high full toss is a cricket delivery of that name.
